Leander Activity Center

Facility Overview

The Leander Activity Center is a 14,400 square-foot multi-use space where programs, camps, and activities are brought to the community through the Parks and Recreation Department.

Pickleball

Pickleball is one of the fastest-growing sports in the country—and it's easy to see why. It's fun, social, and great for all ages and skill levels.

Join us at the Leander Activity Center for open play sessions twice a week.

  • Schedule: Mondays & Wednesdays, 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  • Cost: $4 per person; $2 for Active Adult Program Member (pay at the door)
  • Location: Leander Activity Center 11880 Hero Way West Suite 600, Leander, TX
  • Details: All ages and experience levels are welcome, no registration required.

Please Note: Our courts are not regulation size—they are a few inches wider and longer than standard dimensions. They are still well-suited for recreational play.
